source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of primary sources (PDF 185-186).

blocks.text: Primary sources (asal sources) woh original material (asal cheez, jaise asal report ya paper) hai jis mein koi tabdeeli nahi ki gayi.

Misal: Jin scientists ne research (tehqeeq) ki, un ka khud likha hua research paper primary source hai. Is ke muqable mein kisi aur ka likha hua us research ka summary (khulasa) secondary source (doosre darje ka source) hoga.

blocks.prompt: Nayi research par akhbar ki khabar primary source hai ya secondary?
blocks.explanation: Secondary source, kyunke yeh asal research paper nahi balke kisi aur ka likha hua us ka khulasa hai.

items: Primary source: asal, tabdeel na kiya hua material (scientists ka research paper); secondary: kisi aur ka khulasa.
